title: Solar Helmet MK2
description: This resource pack changes the solar helmet module texture.
body:
This resource pack transforms the base texture of [solar helmet](https://modrinth.com/mod/solarhelmet) module to a  more modern look that resembles a micro-chip with a little solar panel on top.this is made for minecraft 1.20.1.

Requires [solar helmet](https://modrinth.com/mod/solarhelmet) to function.

![module](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95e38580690c808f38d0d5ed6b4478c12e6a1e32.png)
